subject.title: fix(agent-tools): add request timeout to remote media fetches

question: Should agent-owned image and PDF media downloads adopt a fixed 15-minute response-header deadline despite breaking endpoints that take longer to return headers?
rationale: The timeout prevents indefinite tool hangs, but the camera precedent covers a different download surface and does not automatically establish the compatibility policy for these agent tools.

options.title: Accept the 15-minute boundary
options.body: Retain the header-only deadline for actual agent-owned remote downloads after removing the ineffective video scope and adding real tool proof.

options.title: Choose another deadline
options.body: Set a different shared duration and provide focused tests and runtime proof for that compatibility choice.

options.title: Keep these callers unbounded
options.body: Decline the behavior change and close the PR if maintainers prefer not to impose a fixed header-arrival ceiling.

recommendation.title: Accept the 15-minute boundary
recommendation.body: Retain the header-only deadline for actual agent-owned remote downloads after removing the ineffective video scope and adding real tool proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced several affected tool surfaces and merged the canonical timeout primitive, providing the strongest historical signal for the cross-tool compatibility decision.
